title: Monthly records
summaryEmpty: No summary yet. A deleted summary can be restored with the same identity.
localOnly: New monthly records are stored on this phone only. WebDAV and complete backup are not connected yet.
savedLocal: Saved on phone; not synced to cloud
timezone: The selected date determines the archive day. Times use the phone's current timezone. Body-only edits preserve the original event time.
empty: No matching records in this month.
readOnly: Reading or format validation failed. Cached content is read-only until verification succeeds.
snapshotFailed: No acknowledged editor document was received, or the document contains unsupported formatting. The draft remains in the editor. Retry or copy its JSON.
emptyBody: The record body cannot be empty.
conflict: This block changed elsewhere, was deleted, or has a summary identity conflict. No newer version was overwritten. Copy the draft, leave, refresh and edit again.
topicUnavailable: This topic was deleted or changed type. No new revision was saved to it. Copy your draft.
uncertain: The save result is unconfirmed. The body and request are locked. Retry the identical request instead of creating another record.
leaveMessage: Leaving discards unsaved changes. To retain them, cancel and copy the draft JSON first.
leaveUncertain: The request may already be saved. Leaving will not undo it. Cancel and retry the same request, or copy the draft JSON and inspect the original record.
deleteTitle: Move this block to recycle bin
heading: Level 2 heading
